_comment: DEPRECATED: prefer falda_tokens.example.json (the canonical file, shared by HTTP and MCP when run via `falda serve`). This file remains only for the standalone `falda gateway` legacy entry point. Same shape/semantics — see docs/API.md 'Authentication' and docs/MCP.md 'Auth model'. Copy to falda_gateway_tokens.json, replace the placeholder tokens (openssl rand -hex 24), and point FALDA_TOKENS at it. Pool-admin routes (/pools/*) require a tenants: ["*"] token.

REPLACE_WITH_ANOTHER_openssl_rand_hex_24.label: fully-trusted internal caller (any tenant; required for /pools/*)
